# Apps by Jihye Kim

> Independent iOS developer Jihye Kim makes small, focused iPhone apps. All are free on the App Store.

## Apps

- [Butto](https://wendoei.github.io/butto/): Stay close to friends who live in other countries and time zones. Each friend's card shows their local time, current weather and local news headlines (translated on your phone). Instead of chatting, you send one-tap emojis that arrive as notifications and are not kept as a history. Also: send a news article to a friend with an emoji, Flipside (a photo or 5-second video on the back of your card), widgets, and adding friends by tapping phones or scanning a QR code. Good for people living or studying abroad, long-distance friends and couples, and friends made while travelling. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/butto/id6761648901
- [Lettrd](https://wendoei.github.io/lettrd/): Lettrd is a free iPhone app that delivers Vincent van Gogh's 907 letters one at a time, in English or Korean, at the pace he actually wrote them. It is not a browsable archive: a letter arrives, you read it, and the wait before the next one is proportional to the gap Van Gogh himself left before writing again. The paintings and the sketches a letter describes are shown beside the text, and there is a timeline of his life by period, from the Netherlands through Paris and Arles to Auvers. The translations were made from the public-domain Dutch and French originals rather than from a copyrighted scholarly edition. You can underline sentences and keep private notes on them; highlights, notes and reading progress sync between your own devices through your private iCloud database and are not sent to Lettrd's servers. No account, no feed, no ads and no in-app purchases. Good for people who wanted to read the letters but bounced off the scale of the archive, readers who want one quiet thing a day, art history students, and Korean readers with little access to the correspondence in translation. Requires iPhone with iOS 18 or later; English and Korean. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/lettrd/id6761928111
- [ChangeHero](https://wendoei.github.io/changehero/): ChangeHero is a free iPhone and iPad game for practising how to pay with real coins and notes and work out the right change, in British pounds, euros, US dollars, Korean won and Japanese yen. Each currency has eight levels: paying for single items and two items, a coins-only round and a 45-second timed round, then change for one item, two items and bigger baskets, and a 30-second timed round. Also: a currency guide showing every coin and note front and back with fun facts and quick quizzes, badges, Game Center achievements, and level progress saved with iCloud. The first currency you choose is free in full; a one-time in-app purchase unlocks the other currency packs, and the app shows ads that a separate purchase removes. Good for travellers before a trip, people moving or studying abroad, new cashiers and students practising money maths. Requires iOS 17 or later; English. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/changehero/id6749336103
- [NiftyConverter](https://wendoei.github.io/niftyconverter/): A simple currency converter with up-to-date exchange rates. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/niftyconverter/id6602884712
